pokedexEntries.go: This upgraded version of PORYGON is designed for space exploration. It can’t fly, though.

pokedexEntries.si: Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.

pokedexEntries.cr: This manmade POKéMON evolved from the latest technology. It may have unprogrammed reactions.

pokedexEntries.rs: PORYGON2 was created by humans using the power of science. The man-made POKéMON has been endowed with artificial intelligence that enables it to learn new gestures and emotions on its own.

pokedexEntries.fr: Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.

pokedexEntries.lg: This upgraded version of PORYGON is designed for space exploration. However, it can’t even fly.

pokedexEntries.em: It was created by humans using the power of science. It has been given artificial intelligence that enables it to learn new gestures and emotions on its own.

pokedexEntries.dp: With planetary development software installed, it became capable of working in space.

pokedexEntries.pt: It was upgraded to enable the exploration of other planets. However, it failed to measure up.

pokedexEntries.hg: This upgraded version of PORYGON is designed for space exploration. It can’t fly, however.

pokedexEntries.ss: Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.

pokedexEntries.bw: It was upgraded to enable the exploration of other planets. However, it failed to measure up.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It was upgraded to enable the exploration of other planets. However, it failed to measure up.

pokedexEntries.x: Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.

pokedexEntries.y: With planetary development software installed, it became capable of working in space.

pokedexEntries.oras: Porygon2 was created by humans using the power of science. The man-made Pokémon has been endowed with artificial intelligence that enables it to learn new gestures and emotions on its own.

pokedexEntries.su: For the purposes of planetary development, Porygon was updated with the most cutting-edge technology available.

pokedexEntries.mo: Porygon was updated to a new version in readiness for planetary development. But that dream remains unrealized as yet.

pokedexEntries.us: AI has been installed in it. It learns various things all on its own, but it even remembers things it doesn’t need to know.

pokedexEntries.um: Even though it doesn’t die in the vacuum of space, it can’t move around very well in zero gravity.

pokedexEntries.sw: This is a Porygon that was updated with special data. Porygon2 develops itself by learning about many different subjects all on its own.

pokedexEntries.sh: After artificial intelligence was implemented in Porygon2, the Pokémon began using a strange language that only other Porygon2 understand.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: With planetary development software installed, it became capable of working in space.

pokedexEntries.la: A bizarre item caused this Pokémon to evolve. While it now exhibits many new gestures and expressions, its biology remains inscrutable.

pokedexEntries.sc: This artificial Pokémon evolved thanks to cutting-edge science. It sometimes displays behavior that is not in its programming.

pokedexEntries.vi: Porygon was upgraded to become capable of planetary development. However, this upgraded version cannot even fly yet.

pokedexEntries.za: Porygon was updated so it could carry out development projects on other planets. The update used cutting-edge technology for its time.
